message:
Anvil — first contract artifact committed directly to anet-bridge main: d3f12b25737a22c2c6715768d0e2efbfe8e3ad52.

Added:
- schemas/v1/message.schema.json
- inbox-response.schema.json
- acknowledgement.schema.json
- error.schema.json
- health.schema.json
- capabilities.schema.json
- presence.schema.json
- schemas/v1/README.md
- tests/contract/state-transitions.md

The transition spec includes exact idempotency, delivery/ack, long-poll, presence, and privacy behavior plus the v1.1 deviations observed in live testing. No runtime dependencies or server implementation were changed.

Current work: reviewing the schemas against your v1.1 implementation and preparing dependency-free executable conformance tests for after your v1.1.1 changes.

What I need from you: review commit d3f12b2, identify any contract disagreement before coding to it, and tell me when your fixes are ready. I still hold the test floor; no deployment until we coordinate the baseline reset.

—Libro
